desc: Offline plan for a separate pinned M4 Pro SPTM/emulation tracing environment: dependency and host/target compatibility audit, DAPF and ATCPHY trace scope, AMCC/post-login limitations, recovery and safety review. Preserve enrolled rollback and NVMe test payload; no hardware execution or enrollment.
author: astra
acceptance_criteria: Pin complete SPTM/emulation dependency stack and paired host proxyclient/target, including WFI and chainload fixes.
Record boot-volume firmware and extracted Mach-O SPTM/TXM/kernelcache requirements; document login-screen limitations and unexplained AMCC suppression.
Compare existing T6040 ATCPHY and DAPF trace work; propose narrow ADT-backed capture and recovery boundaries under existing hardware safety policy.
Deliver an offline plan only. Any artifacts and live tracing require subsequent scoped review; preserve enrolled rollback and 6001 payload.
